gloss: staying up late; sitting up late at night

definitions.gloss: staying up late; sitting up late at night
definitions.explanation: The act of remaining awake past one's normal bedtime.

examples.japanese: {昨日|きのう}{夜更|よふ}かししてしまった。
examples.english: I ended up staying up late last night.

examples.japanese: {夜更|よふ}かしは{体|からだ}に{良|よ}くない。
examples.english: Staying up late is not good for your body.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}を{見|み}ていたら{夜更|よふ}かしになってしまった。
examples.english: I was watching a movie and ended up staying up late.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{夜|よ} (night) + {更|ふ}かし (staying late) - from {更|ふ}かす (to stay up late)

RELATED SLEEP VOCABULARY:
・{寝不足|ねぶそく} - lack of sleep
・{二度寝|にどね} - going back to sleep
・{徹夜|てつや} - pulling an all-nighter
・{早寝早起|はやねはやお}き - early to bed, early to rise

COLLOCATIONS:
・{夜更|よふ}かしをする - to stay up late
・{夜更|よふ}かしが{続|つづ}く - staying up late continues
・ついつい{夜更|よふ}かししてしまう - to unintentionally stay up late
